title: 7343 Hongkong Reneue Scandal Bared

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, APRIL 3, 1936

HONGKONG REVENUE
SCANDAL BARED

An Attempt To Bribe
Native Staff Of
Department

ONE FOREIGNER, EIGHT
CHINESE CHARGED

HONGKONG, April 2.—What
is considered to have been an at-
tempt on the part of powerful
smuggling interests to bribe the
entire native staff of the revenue
department in order to evade the
Colony's opium laws, was reveal-
ed here to-day.

The disclosure was made in the
Police Court by Mr. Tim Murphy,
Assistant Director of Criminal
Intelligence when eight men, one
foreigner and seven Chinese, were
charged with evading the opium
laws.

The case was remanded until
Saturday pending further police
investigations.

The foreigner involved gave his
name as Albert Randall. His
nationality is unknown.—Reuter.

（批：Ricardo 3/4/36 Kinfucian 0.5.6.）
（批：e.g. 6 / d.R）
（右上角手写注记：7343 3 11 36）
